label: April 2025
highlight: TUSOME received mentoring from Queen's University on integrating vocational skills into its platform, in line with Tanzania's competence-based curriculum.

label: May 2025
highlight: TABASAM was showcased at the eLearning Africa conference, and user testing led to a faster way of generating personalised learning plans.

label: June 2025
highlight: The team took part in technical boot camps and AI and data science workshops, and applied the skills to refine TABASAM's features.

label: July 2025
highlight: Teachers in Korogwe were trained to use the TABASAM diagnostic tool to identify and respond to learners' needs.

label: August 2025
highlight: Korogwe teachers received online mentoring on using TABASAM reports to plan classroom support, and TABASAM was presented at a learning conference in Nairobi.
priority: Train educators in more schools and a teachers' college to use TABASAM for early identification of learning challenges.

label: September 2025
highlight: TABASAM's navigation and reports were improved, and a signed agreement with Cardinal Rugambwa Hospital extended its use to a children's rehabilitation programme.
priority: Run refresher training with teachers in Tanga and Mwanza to support TABASAM use and gather feedback.

label: October 2025
highlight: Design work began on a TABASAM dashboard to help teachers and partners track learner progress in literacy, numeracy and behaviour.
priority: Complete the TABASAM monitoring dashboard prototype for clearer reporting and progress tracking.

label: November 2025
highlight: TABASAM was introduced to teachers in more Korogwe schools, and a baseline survey of teachers' digital readiness began with Carnegie Mellon University.
priority: Finalise the TABASAM dashboard prototype for internal testing and run AI literacy and inclusion workshops for teachers.

label: December 2025
highlight: Teachers in Korogwe District government schools were introduced to updated TABASAM features and gave structured feedback.
priority: Monitor teachers' use of TABASAM and analyse follow-up survey data with Carnegie Mellon University to guide product improvements.

label: January 2026
highlight: TABASAM-informed classroom practice and data collection continued in Korogwe District schools, alongside a research testbed with Carnegie Mellon University.
priority: Monitor learning outcomes and analyse January data with research partners to inform improvements to TABASAM.

label: February 2026
highlight: Classroom observations and teacher engagement in Korogwe District informed improvements to TABASAM's usability.
priority: Continue research data analysis with Carnegie Mellon University and expand engagement with participating schools.

label: March 2026
highlight: Teacher candidates and professors from Queen's University visited schools and institutions where TABASAM is in use.
priority: Onboard newly engaged schools to TABASAM and explore collaboration with a teachers' college.

label: April 2026
highlight: TUSOME followed up with partner schools to support teachers, monitor TABASAM use and gather feedback on classroom integration.
priority: Continue engagement with partner schools and educators, and keep gathering user feedback on TABASAM.

label: May 2026
highlight: New schools were onboarded to TABASAM, and analysis of the Korogwe study data continued with Carnegie Mellon University.
priority: Support newly onboarded schools and complete analysis of the Korogwe research data with Carnegie Mellon University.

label: June 2026
highlight: TABASAM supported learning activities in a June school-holiday programme.
priority: Document lessons from the holiday learning programme and expand school and community outreach.

label: July 2026
highlight: Development work focused on linking TABASAM assessment results to practical recommendations for teachers.
priority: Continue documenting evidence and lessons from TABASAM implementation to inform decisions on scale.

label: August 2026
highlight: TUSOME was invited to speak about TABASAM's use in assessment and inclusive education at an international education conference.
priority: Strengthen the practical use of TABASAM in educational assessment with participating institutions.

label: September 2026
highlight: TABASAM was used to support a pilot of Grade 2 examinations.
priority: Consolidate lessons from the Grade 2 examination pilot and identify improvements to TABASAM's assessment functions.

label: October 2026
highlight: TUSOME Technologies Limited was formed, succeeding TUSOME Education Consulting.
priority: Inform customers and partners about the transition to TUSOME Technologies Limited, while continuing TABASAM implementation.
